runner_source_analysis.finding: The exact annotation is emitted when the worker shutdown token is canceled with internal reason UserCancelled. That enum name does not identify a person or the signal sender.

paths.finding: UserCancelled emits the observed annotation; OperatingSystemShutdown has different text.
Ordinary CancelRequest cancels the job token. RunnerShutdown cancels the runner token with UserCancelled.
Worker unloading maps to UserCancelled without retaining signal or sender identity.
Listener unloading has the same mapping.
Service TERM/INT forwards SIGINT; RunnerService.js then forwards SIGINT to the listener.
Lost job-lock renewal normally sends CancelRequest; RunnerShutdown requires the listener shutdown token already canceled.

runner_source_analysis.unresolved: The annotation alone cannot identify the initiator or establish/exclude resource starvation, service shutdown, or an OS shutdown delivered through Unix signals.
